## What's new
- **c$ Share opens Dockett.** The button (renamed from "C Share") now opens [Dockett](https://github.com/hiramatx/dockett), a dual pane file manager, instead of two File Explorer windows. The left pane shows your own profile on this PC (`C:\Users\<you without -admin>`) and the right pane shows `\\PC\c$`. Dockett runs as the account the app runs as, so `c$` opens without a credential prompt even when the app was started with "Run as different user".
- If the remote PC's `c$` can't be reached, a message says so instead of opening Dockett on the wrong folder.
- Dockett 0.1.0 (portable, win-x64) is included in `Tools\Dockett\`. Its settings and tabs are saved per user in `%APPDATA%\Dockett`.

## Upgrading from v5.2.0
- Extract the new zip over the old folder, or into a new one. `Tools\Dockett\` is new.
- No Config files changed, so you can keep yours as they are.

## Download & run
Download `HelpDeskProTools-v5.3.0-win-x64-self-contained.zip`, extract it, and run `HelpDeskProTools.exe` (ideally as your `-admin` account).

This build is **self-contained**: .NET is included, so nothing needs to be installed on the PC. It runs as-is from a local folder or a file share.
